physics_configuration.document: docs/ORACLE_BUDGET.md: one row per fixture of every G3 case file present under docs/validation/cases, giving the oracle class, its independence from the code under test, the precision floor, the time window and the PML budget as recorded, plus the open residuals per task
physics_configuration.case_files: docs/validation/cases/G3-*.json with the fields oracle_class (list) and tests.layers (one entry per tests.existing id with layer, oracle_class and oracle)
physics_configuration.classes: analytic_continuum, analytic_discrete, independent_solver, physical_invariant, convergence_study (layer B); shared_discrete_operator, finite_difference_same_discretisation, independent_implementation_same_scheme (layer A); stored_record (either)

reference_method: Consistency of the documents of record with each other: every G3 case names allowed oracle classes, every listed test carries a layer consistent with its class and exists in its source file, the tasks G3-06, G3-09, G3-10, G3-11, G3-12 and G3-16 keep at least one layer-B entry, G3-14 and G3-15 are layer A only, and docs/ORACLE_BUDGET.md names every case id and every class.
